title: stenophyllus capillaris subsp. tenuifolius
intro: Stenophyllus capillaris subsp. tenuifolius, commonly known as Slender Stenophyllus, is a plant species within the family Euphorbiaceae. It is a plant used in traditional medicine, valued for its health benefits, including its potential to lower blood pressure and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, that exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. Additionally, Stenophyllus capillaris subsp. tenuifolius has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its expectorant and antiseptic properties.
